description: This file contains utility functions for generating mock data, including data type generators, data insertion, and sample data creation for testing purposes within the Superset project.

classes.name: ColumnInfo
classes.description: TypedDict defining the structure of column metadata used for data generation.

methods.name: get_type_generator
methods.description: Returns a data generator function based on the SQLAlchemy column type.

methods.name: add_data
methods.description: Generates and inserts synthetic data into a specified table, creating the table if necessary.

methods.name: get_column_objects
methods.description: Converts a list of column metadata dictionaries into SQLAlchemy Column objects.

methods.name: generate_data
methods.description: Creates a list of dictionaries representing rows of generated data for given columns.

methods.name: generate_column_data
methods.description: Generates a list of data values for a specific column based on its type.

methods.name: add_sample_rows
methods.description: Creates and yields sample model instances with generated or copied data.

methods.name: get_valid_foreign_key
methods.description: Fetches a valid foreign key value from the referenced table.

methods.name: generate_value
methods.description: Generates a random value for a column, considering special cases like JSON or enums.
